description: The SIM-VICUS repository identifies a three-dimensional building and district-network environment using the NANDRAD simulation engine and redirects development to VICUS Software. The current provider distinguishes Buildings and Districts products for dynamic building and heat-network assessment, running locally on Windows and Linux. Commercial licences and trials are described. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (VICUS; free student licence). Published by ghorwin (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Software access is paid under the provider’s terms. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
